node.statement: On the guarded principal branch of deployed positive 433-1b role cell 4, every case with missing outside record xi=0 and canonical residual matching 0 is empty across all four source signs and four target lanes. The opposite-DE target-free element has a quadratic-over-quadratic norm whose degree-298 numerator has exactly five deployed-field roots in each source-sign row. Adding roots of every inverse numerator, inverse denominator, and norm denominator yields exactly seven candidates per row. Five hit r guards and the remaining two lift only to t^2+1=0. There are no route-open source points, witnesses, free fibers, or unresolved boundaries. The target-free cut is lane-independent, so four exact sign computations pay all 16 raw cases. The other 104 missing/matching slices in cell 4 remain open.
